title: Create It, Then Count It
prompt: Two steps in one program: (1) write input.txt containing EXACTLY these four lines, one per line: alpha, beta, gamma, delta. (2) Read the file back and print the number of lines (just the number).

tests.name: prints the line count
tests.code:
with open("input.txt", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _c = _f.read()
assert _c == "alpha
beta
gamma
delta
", f"file content wrong: {_c!r}"
assert printed[0] == "4", f"got {printed}"
tests.hint: Write the four lines with a trailing \n each; then with open(...) as f: print(len(f.readlines())).
